The '''Esh-kha vault''' was one of many [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] vaults constructed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] to contain the [[Esh-kha]]. This particular vault was located in the [[Outer Wastes]] of the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Black (captain)|Black]] led his unit on an ill-fated mission into the vault.
